request.style: English, male soulful voice, solo with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, tambourine, mournful yet hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Moses the servant of the Lord is dead
Now get up and cross this Jordan
Every place where the sole of your foot treads
I have given you just as promised
From the wilderness to the great sea
All this shall be your territory
No one will be able to stand against you
As I was with Moses so I will be with you

[Chorus]
Be strong and courageous
For you will give this people possession
Do not be terrified or dismayed
The Lord your God is with you

[Verse]
Joshua and Caleb tore their clothes
Saying the land is exceedingly good
If the Lord delights in us
He will bring us into this land
Flowing with milk and honey
Their protection is gone and the Lord is with us
Do not fear them

[Chorus]
Be strong and courageous
For you will give this people possession
Do not be terrified or dismayed
The Lord your God is with you

[Verse]
The Jordan was overflowing its banks
As it does all through the harvest season
The feet of the priests touched the water's edge
The water standing in a single heap
So the people crossed over opposite Jericho
The priests stood firm on dry ground
In the middle of the Jordan
All Israel crossed on dry ground

[Chorus]
Be strong and courageous
For you will give this people possession
Do not be terrified or dismayed
The Lord your God is with you

[Bridge]
March around the city with all your soldiers
Circling it once for six days
Seven priests carry seven ram's-horn trumpets
On the seventh day march seven times
The walls will fall at the sound of the trumpets
As for me and my house
We will serve the Lord

[Outro]
Be strong and courageous
Do not be terrified or dismayed
The Lord your God is with you
Wherever you go
